author: OpenBank Security
notes: Verified 2026-10-05 against current-source communication-service runtimeClasspath, its built fast-jar and its 289-component CycloneDX SBOM. Trivy 0.74.0 reported CVE-2025-14969 on the exact Hibernate Reactive artifact. This review does not cover the deployed container's OS packages; retain their findings under investigation until that image is scanned. Reassess on artifact or scanner-database changes.

statements.impact_statement: Communication-service's built fast-jar contains org.hibernate.reactive:hibernate-reactive-core 3.4.2.Final with SHA-256 7e7443b2b5313b043af3d9448499f44059fa77729ddb9e369c4a2b9a9cea075c, matching gradle/verification-metadata.xml. The same exact JAR bytecode was checked against upstream fix cd7f104e10de918004707ca0e26e3840976f780a: SqlClientConnection.close() first invokes validateNoTransactionInProgressOnClose(); that guard checks SqlConnection.transaction(), rolls back an open transaction and returns a failed validation stage; the close continuation still closes the underlying SqlConnection. The advisory's <4.2.1 range spans parallel release lines; the vulnerable close implementation is absent from this resolved artifact.
